setup:
# OAuth credentials are untracked — pull them from the main checkout if missing.
  if [[ ! -f electron/.env.local ]]; then
    MAIN="$(git worktree list --porcelain | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')"
    [[ -f "$MAIN/electron/.env.local" ]] && cp "$MAIN/electron/.env.local" electron/.env.local
  fi

  (cd go && go mod download && go build -o bistro-sync ./cmd/bistro-sync)
  (cd electron && npm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false pnpm install)
teardown:
# Kill anything still running out of THIS worktree (engine + electron).
  # The engine's stdin watchdog normally handles this, but belt-and-braces.
  WT="$(pwd)"
  pkill -f "$WT" 2>/dev/null || true
  sleep 1

  # Warn (don't fail) if the DB is somehow still held.
  lsof go/sync.db >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "WARN: go/sync.db still held in $WT" >&2 || true
run:
(cd go && go build -o bistro-sync ./cmd/bistro-sync)
cd electron && npm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false pnpm start
